decisions.reason: Although analytics fits the firm's positioning, the GA4 plugin disappeared from the website after only limited public commitment, so management has little reason to keep escalating resources into it.
The Universal Analytics plugin lost market relevance, and with only brief website mention the firm lacks enough visible commitment to justify persisting with it.
The retail system interface plugin used development resources, but its quick disappearance from the website suggests weak traction and too little public commitment to sustain further commitment.
This service remained on its own page across both years and is central to the firm's relaunch and SEO promise, so management is likely to persist and treat any disappointing results as temporary.
As a recently launched offer with a dedicated page and clear fit to the firm's search-marketing expertise, management is likely to give the workshops more time instead of dropping them early.
